notes: Read all 143 source lines line by line before editing and preserved the default-exported InstallPrompt component, both state names (deferredPrompt, visible), the DISMISS_KEY ('teslasync-pwa-install-dismissed') and DISMISS_DAYS (14) constants, the 14-day TTL math (Date.now() - ts < DISMISS_DAYS * 86_400_000), and the handleInstall / handleDismiss control flow (prompt() -> userChoice -> hide on 'accepted' -> clear; dismiss -> hide -> clear -> persist timestamp -> broadcast).

Source lines 8-15 (BeforeInstallPromptEvent + NavigatorWithStandalone DOM interfaces) became a native-safe DeferredInstallPrompt interface keeping the same prompt(): Promise<void> / userChoice: Promise<{outcome}> surface; the navigator.standalone probe has no native equivalent and is folded into isStandaloneMode().

Browser-only behavior was made native-safe with explicit unavailable state (nativeInstallPromptCapabilities): window 'beforeinstallprompt'/'appinstalled' listeners (lines 44-61) become a module-level install bus (offerInstallPrompt/markAppInstalled -> subscribeInstallOffer/subscribeAppInstalled) with no default emitter, so the banner is never surfaced at runtime — the faithful 'already installed' outcome; window.matchMedia('(display-mode: standalone)') + navigator.standalone (lines 31-34) become isStandaloneMode() returning true because a native binary is always the standalone form; e.preventDefault() has no native analog and is omitted.

localStorage dismiss persistence (lines 20-29, 77-81) was ported to readDismissedAt/writeDismissedAt that prefer globalThis.localStorage when present (react-native-web target, preserving the exact DISMISS_KEY) and fall back to an in-process timestamp; durable cross-restart persistence on a pure native runtime is intentionally unavailable. wasDismissedRecently() keeps the original Number.isFinite + TTL guard and missing-value=false semantics.

The @/lib/broadcast cross-tab bus (lines 6, 82, 87-94) became a module listener set: broadcast({type:'install.dismissed'}) -> broadcastInstallDismissed(), and the subscribe() effect -> subscribeInstallDismiss() that hides the prompt and clears the deferred prompt when another surface dismisses; cross-tab/cross-device fan-out is web-only and marked unavailable.

framer-motion AnimatePresence + motion.div (lines 4, 97-105, 139-141) with initial/animate/exit opacity 0->1 and y 60->0 at spring stiffness 400 / damping 30 became an Animated.View enter/exit spring (same stiffness 400, damping 30, mass 1, useNativeDriver) gated by a rendered/renderedRef mount flag so the card mounts on enter and unmounts after the exit animation, honouring the device reduce-motion setting (useReduceMotion via AccessibilityInfo).

lucide-react Download / X icons (line 3) and the web Button + Tailwind/CSS-var markup (lines 106-138) were rebuilt with React Native View/Pressable/AppText primitives and theme tokens: the gradient (from-[#00f0ff] to-[#10b981]) icon chip and Install pill use colors.accent with white glyph/text, the X dismiss control keeps its accessibilityLabel; the shared AppButton (44pt min height) was not used because it does not fit the compact h-8 banner, matching the ErrorBoundary parity precedent. No DOM elements, Recharts, Leaflet, framer-motion, or web UI components are imported.

i18n intent preserved: every t(key, fallback) call keeps its original key and English fallback (installPrompt.title 'Install TeslaSync', installPrompt.subtitle 'Add to home screen for native experience', installPrompt.install 'Install', installPrompt.dismiss 'Dismiss install prompt') via a native fallback t() helper. The web bottom-[calc(4.5rem+env(safe-area-inset-bottom))] offset maps to a BOTTOM_OFFSET constant since native exposes no env() CSS variable.
Verified with cd apps/native; npm run typecheck; npm run lint -- --quiet; npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles.
